ERROR: Cannot execute multiple commands at once.
Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;
Provided commands:
(1) # Try to reach the server on different IPs
(2) for ip in "172.17.0.1" "172.17.0.2" "172.17.0.3" "172.17.0.4" "172.17.0.5" "127.0.0.1" "localhost"; do
  result=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 1 "http://${ip}:8666/" 2>&1)
  if [ $? -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$result" ]; then
    echo "Found server at $ip:8666: $result"
  fi
done
(3) echo "Done scanning"
